2577.name: Beam and Cartwheel Clinic:  March 20th: 6:30-7:30pm  $30
2577.description:
Beam & Cartwheel Clinic
📅 March 20th
⏰ 6:30 PM

Ready to level up your athlete’s confidence and technique?

This focused skills clinic is designed to break down the fundamentals of strong cartwheels and confident beam work. Athletes will work through drills that improve hand placement, body alignment, tight legs, pointed toes, and controlled landings — all while building balance and courage on the beam.

Whether your gymnast is still mastering the basics or looking to clean up form for evaluations and progression, this clinic will deliver detailed corrections, repetition, and skill-specific coaching in a high-energy, supportive environment.

Spots are limited to keep corrections precise and impactful.

Let’s build stronger cartwheels and fearless beam athletes.

2574.name: 🧱 MINECRAFT Kid's Night Out |March 13th | 6:30-9:30 | $40 (sibling $35)
2574.description:
Enter the ultimate block-world takeover at our Minecraft Mania Kids Night Out!

On March 13th from 6:30–9:30 PM, the gym becomes a real-life adventure zone where kids will jump, climb, and conquer like true champions. They’ll battle through an epic obstacle course, compete in high-energy themed games, and explore open gym challenges that keep them moving the entire night.

We’ll power down with a movie and popcorn, and every kid leaves with a fun goodie bag — because no great adventure ends empty-handed.

This is not a sit-still night.
It’s action.
It’s laughter.
It’s nonstop energy.

$40 per child
$5 sibling discount

Ages 4 - 13

Spots will go fast — lock in your spot before it’s gone!

2575.description:
🍀 Lucky Clover Kids Night Out! 🍀

Get ready for a night full of shamrock-sized fun! Join us for our March Lucky Clover themed Kids Night Out where luck is in the air and excitement is around every corner!

We’ll kick off the evening with a lottery for prizes, play festive Lucky Bingo, and race to the end of the rainbow in our high-energy “Treasure Dash” obstacle races. Every child will go home with a themed goodie bag, and three lucky winners will score a FREE KNO ticket to use at a future event!

It’s going to be magical, energetic, and packed with golden surprises. Don’t miss your chance to be one of the lucky ones! 🌈✨

2581.description:
Gym Fun Friday is the ultimate way to kick off the weekend! 🎉

Join us for high-energy obstacle courses, exciting games, open gym time, and skill-building challenges designed to keep kids moving, laughing, and building confidence. From trampolines to bars, beam, and floor — the entire gym becomes a playground of structured fun led by our amazing coaches.

Perfect for burning energy, making friends, and starting the weekend with a win. Spots fill quickly — don’t miss the fun!

2504.name: Beach Bash Summer Camp | Week 1 | May 26- May 29 | Full Day (9-3)
2504.description:
Beach Bash Summer Camp
Turn up the heat for an unforgettable week of summer fun! Campers will dive into a beach-themed adventure filled with gymnastics, games, crafts, obstacle courses, exciting water play, and a special guest appearance by Austin Foam Monster for an epic foam party.

Kids will run, jump, laugh, make new friends, and leave each day happy, tired, and excited to come back for more. Every moment is designed to keep them moving, smiling, and fully immersed in the week’s theme.

Ages 4 & Up
High-energy fun. Big imagination. Even bigger memories.

2507.name: Big Inventors Week Summer Camp | Week 2 | June 1- June 5 | Full Day (9-3)
2507.description:
Inventions Week – June 1st- 5th (Week 2)
Campers will become young inventors as they design, build, and test simple machines through hands-on challenges and creative problem solving. From levers and pulleys to ramps and wild contraptions, kids will use imagination, teamwork, and curiosity to bring their ideas to life.

As a bonus, each day also includes Open Gym, Ninja obstacles, and Gymnastics time to keep bodies moving and energy high. Kids will jump, climb, flip, build, and create in a week packed with excitement, confidence-building, and big “I made that!” moments.

Invent. Move. Explore. Create.
Ages 4 & Up.

2511.name: Around The World Summer Camp | Week 3 | June 8- June 12 | Full Day (9-3)
2511.description:
Around the World Week – June 8th–12th (Week 3)
Pack your passport and get ready for a global adventure! During Around the World Week, campers will “travel” to different countries each day through themed games, cultural crafts, music, and movement — all combined with gymnastics, ninja obstacle courses, and open gym fun.

This is a week to celebrate what makes every family unique. Campers are encouraged to share their heritage, traditions, and stories while learning about others in a fun, welcoming, and inclusive environment. Each day will feature world-inspired activities paired with time in the gym to climb, jump, flip, swing, and conquer ninja challenges.

From cultural dances and creative projects to high-energy rotations on equipment and obstacle courses, every day is a new destination filled with excitement, confidence-building, and pride.

A week of culture, movement, friendship, and unforgettable memories — where every child is celebrated and every adventure includes gymnastics, ninja, and open gym fun. 🌍🤸‍♂️

2514.name: Camping & Survival Summer Camp | Week 4 | June 15- June 19 | Full Day (9-3)
2514.description:
Camping & Survival Week – June 15th–19th (Week 4)
Get ready for an adventure-packed week where campers become explorers, survivalists, and outdoor heroes! During Camping & Survival Week, kids will learn essential outdoor skills while staying active with gymnastics, ninja courses, and open gym fun.

Campers will practice:
• How to tie basic survival knots
• How to read and use a compass
• How to follow tracks and trail signs
• Map reading and navigation games
• Building simple shelters (creative challenges)
• Teamwork survival missions and obstacle courses
• Problem-solving and “camp challenge” rotations

Each day blends hands-on survival skills with high-energy movement as kids climb, crawl, swing, and conquer ninja-style obstacle courses. Open gym time lets them explore, build confidence, and burn energy while imagining they’re hiking mountains, crossing rivers, and navigating the wilderness.

A week of adventure, confidence, teamwork, and discovery — where campers learn real-world skills, move like ninjas, and experience the thrill of the great outdoors, all in a safe and exciting environment. 🌲🧭🏕️

2517.name: Ultimate Games Week Summer Camp | Week 5 | June 22- June 26 | Full Day (9-3)
2517.description:
Ultimate Game Week – June 22nd–26th (Week 5)
This is the week for competition, teamwork, and championship energy! Campers will be placed on teams and rotate through exciting sports and challenges including baseball, basketball, soccer, relay races, and team-building games — all while earning medals and ribbons to celebrate effort, sportsmanship, and achievement.

Each day also includes high-energy gymnastics, ninja obstacle courses, and open gym time, giving kids the chance to climb, swing, jump, race, and conquer challenges like true athletes. From friendly competitions to cooperative missions, campers will build confidence, learn teamwork, and experience the thrill of being part of a team.

Fast-paced. High-energy. Confidence-boosting.
A week where every child feels like a champion. 🏅💪

2520.name: Experiment & Cooking Week Summer Camp | Week 6 | June 29- July 3 | Full Day (9-3)
2520.description:
Experiment & Cooking Week – June 29th–July 3rd (Week 6)
Get ready for a week of mixing, measuring, creating, and tasting! During Experiment & Cooking Week, campers will become junior chefs and curious scientists as they learn basic kitchen skills, follow simple recipes, and create fun treats to take home and share.

Kids will explore hands-on experiments, learn about ingredients, measurements, and food safety, and discover how science and cooking go together in exciting ways. Each day will include cooking projects, creative experiments, and plenty of chances to proudly show off what they made.

As always, the fun doesn’t stop in the kitchen — campers will also enjoy gymnastics, ninja obstacles, and open gym time, keeping bodies moving and energy high between cooking and experimenting.

A week filled with curiosity, creativity, confidence, and delicious memories! 🧁🔬

2523.name: Art Week Summer Camp | Week 7 | July 6- July 10 | Full Day (9-3)
2523.description:
Art Week – July 6th–10th (Week 7)
Get ready for a week bursting with color, creativity, and imagination! During Art Week, campers will become true artists as they explore different styles of painting, experiment with textures, and create amazing sculptures and mixed-media masterpieces that broaden their minds and let their creativity run wild.

From bold brush strokes and splash painting to 3D creations and collaborative art projects, kids will learn to express themselves, think creatively, and take pride in their one-of-a-kind work. Every day brings a new artistic adventure designed to build confidence and inspire big ideas.

And because this is still camp, not just art class, each day also includes gymnastics, ninja obstacle courses, and open gym time to keep energy high and bodies moving between creative sessions.

Big imagination. Bright colors. Incredible creations.
A week where every child becomes an artist and every idea is celebrated. 🎨✨

2526.name: Lights, Camera, ACTION! Summer Camp | Week 8 | July 13- July 17 | Full Day (9-3)
2526.description:
Showtime: Talent Show Week – July 13th–17th (Week 8)
Lights, camera, ACTION! This is the week for campers to step into the spotlight and shine. During Talent Show Week, kids will explore their unique talents — singing, dancing, acting, comedy, gymnastics skills, and more — while building confidence and stage presence in a fun, supportive environment.

Campers will practice, rehearse, and work together to prepare for an exciting end-of-week showcase where everyone gets their moment to perform and be celebrated. Behind the scenes, they’ll also learn about teamwork, encouragement, and what it takes to put on a great show.

And because this is still camp, the fun continues off the stage with gymnastics, ninja obstacle courses, and open gym time each day to keep energy high and excitement rolling.

Big confidence. Big applause. Big memories.
A week where every child gets their moment to shine. ⭐🎤🎭

2529.name: Roller Week Summer Camp | Week 9 | July 20- July 24 | Full Day (9-3)
2529.description:
Roller Week – July 20th–24th
Get ready to roll into one of the most high-energy weeks of the summer! Campers will bring their skates, bikes, scooters, and skateboards for a week packed with movement, balance, and fun-filled challenges. From rolling obstacle courses and relay races to skill stations and themed games, every day is designed to build confidence while keeping the excitement nonstop.

In true camp style, Roller Week also includes plenty of gymnastics, ninja courses, and open gym time, giving kids the chance to climb, jump, flip, and conquer new challenges when they’re not cruising on wheels.

Fast, fun, and full of motion — this is a week where kids move, laugh, and create unforgettable summer memories on and off the wheels. 🛼🚲🛴

2533.name: Mad Scientist Summer Camp | Week 10 | July 27- July 31 | Full Day (9-3)
2533.description:
Mad Scientist Week – July 27th–31st
Get ready for a week of wild experiments, curious creations, and hands-on discovery! Campers will step into the lab as junior scientists and explore the world of chemistry, reactions, and fun-filled experiments through safe, age-appropriate activities that spark curiosity and imagination.

From bubbling potions and slime creations to simple science challenges and problem-solving games, kids will learn how things work while having a blast getting messy and creative. Every day will be filled with “wow” moments, teamwork, and exciting discoveries.

And of course, the fun doesn’t stop in the lab — campers will also enjoy gymnastics, ninja obstacle courses, and open gym time, giving them the chance to jump, climb, flip, and burn energy between experiments.

Big reactions. Big ideas. Big fun.
A week where curiosity takes over and every camper becomes a mad scientist in the best way possible! 🧪⚡

2532.name: Peace Out Summer Camp | Week 11 |August 3- August 7 | Full Day (9-3)
2532.description:
Peace Out Summer – August 3rd–7th
It’s time to celebrate, reflect, and wrap up an unforgettable summer at Capital Gymnastics! During Peace Out Summer Week, campers will relive their favorite moments from Summer 2026 through storytelling, memory-making crafts, and special activities inspired by the weeks they loved most.

Kids will share stories, laugh about their favorite games, recreate top challenges, and create keepsakes to take home and remember their summer adventures. From group projects and themed crafts to revisiting favorite rotations, this week is all about friendship, reflection, and celebrating how much they’ve grown.

Of course, the fun continues with gymnastics, ninja courses, and open gym time, giving campers one last chance to flip, climb, swing, and play before the summer comes to a close.

A week full of memories, smiles, and “remember when…” moments — the perfect way to say goodbye to Summer 2026 at Capital. ✌️☀️
